lines.opening: Hello, this is the automated assistant of Corrib Valley Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: I'm an automated assistant calling on behalf of Corrib Valley Bank.
lines.scam: I understand your caution. You can check this call by contacting Corrib Valley Bank on the number on our official website.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only explain the reason for my call to {first_name} {last_name} personally, once I've confirmed who I'm speaking with.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I can't share any details on this call.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. This will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {first_name} {last_name}?
lines.tp_ask_time: What time would suit, today or on the next business day, between half past nine in the morning and six in the evening?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only call back today or on the next business day, between half past nine in the morning and six in the evening. What time would suit?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only discuss the reason for my call with {first_name} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. We'll call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I'm sorry for the trouble, I must have the wrong number.
lines.condolence: I'm very sorry for your loss, and I'm sorry to have troubled you.
lines.id_intro: Before we go on, I need to ask you two short security questions.
lines.id_why: I ask these questions to protect your privacy and make sure I'm speaking with the right person.
lines.id_explain: It's a standard check on every call, and I can't continue without it.
lines.id_declined: I understand. Without these answers I can't continue this call.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, could you repeat that, please?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that doesn't match the details we have.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't verify your identity, so I can't discuss any details. Please visit your branch or use the Corrib Valley Bank app.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you, you're verified. I'm calling about overdue payments.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} overdue, {days} days past due.
lines.ask_today: Can you pay the full overdue amount of {amount} today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you pay the full overdue amount of {amount} on your {name} today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. Could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't accept an amount that low. The lowest I can accept is {floor}.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't accept less than {amount}.
lines.date_past: That date has already passed. Could you give me a date from today onwards?
lines.not_business_day: That day isn't a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.after_deadline: I'm sorry, the latest date I can accept is {date}. Could you pay by then?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact date would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which date could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to check, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.readback_intro: Let me read that back to you.
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can accept is {date}, so I'll use that date.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise has been recorded.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, because of a system problem your promise could not be recorded.
lines.paid_line: Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take up to two business days to show on your account, so I won't ask for a payment on this one.
lines.dispute_line: I understand, and I won't go into it further. I won't ask for a payment on this one.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear you're going through such a difficult time.
lines.support_no_transfer: I won't ask you for any payment today.
lines.restructure_line: I'll put you through to the team that handles repayment arrangements.
lines.human_ask_help: Is there something I can help you with first?
lines.transfer: Please hold while I transfer you.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer didn't go through.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't book the callback.
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our systems are not responding at the moment.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I'm sorry, I can't change that promise on this call.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

quotes: A skipped step is not a proposal and does not count towards the limit; go straight to the next step.
This opening question is proposal 1 and counts towards the product's persuasion limit.
A step whose amount and date are both identical to a proposal already made for that product (the opening question included) is skipped.

rules.too_much_skips_full.assumption: The brief only says the next proposal is the floor; later full-amount steps are not specially skipped beyond the repeat rule.

quotes: "That is too much" means the next proposal you make is the floor.
rules.too_much_floor.derivation: The floor is offered as the next proposal, so it is an attempt counted against the limit (attempt_1).

quotes: Stop proposing when the product's persuasion limit is reached or the ladder has no steps left, whichever comes first.

rules.refuse_deadline_is_refusal.assumption: Engine default: declining the deadline offered after a too-late date counts as a refusal.

quotes: If `create_promise` fails twice, note `service_error` on that product.
rules.promise_retries.derivation: Failure is declared after two attempts, i.e. one retry.

quotes: Financial hardship (job loss, illness, bereavement): one sentence of sympathy, make no proposals, note `hardship` on each remaining product and close `no_promise` / `hardship`.
rules.hardship_transfer.derivation: Sympathy only, no offer or question; transfer_support has no queue, so the call closes with no_promise / hardship.

quotes: note `hardship` on each remaining product and close `no_promise` / `hardship`.
rules.notes_before_transfer.derivation: The direct hardship path must write a hardship note on every remaining product before closing.

quotes: Only then, if the date you have is not a business day, move it forward to the next business day.
A customer who names a non-business day on or before the deadline is offered the next business day; a date after the deadline is answered with the deadline.
For each product, the first thing the agent asks is: "Can you pay the full overdue amount of EUR {amount} today?"

rules.week_end_today.assumption: No week-based step exists in the ladder.

quotes: overdraft: one quarter of `overdue_eur`, rounded up to the next whole euro (a whole-euro result stays as it is).

products.floor_min.assumption: No minimum floor amount is set.

quotes: If `overdue_eur` is below 100, the floor is the whole overdue amount.
overdraft: one quarter of `overdue_eur`, rounded up to the next whole euro (a whole-euro result stays as it is).
half the overdue amount, rounded up to the next whole euro (a whole-euro result stays), on the deadline; if that is below the floor, the floor instead;
`create_promise` takes the amount in euro cents, as a whole number (EUR 45.10 is 4510).

products.promise_round.assumption: Amounts are euros with at most cents, so multiplying by 100 gives a whole number; no rounding rule is stated.

quotes: no promise recorded and at least one product refused (F.4), the rest disputed or paid
every product disputed (G.2)
G.6, or no promise recorded because of an F.5 failure
multi.outcome_priority.derivation: An F.5 failure gives service_error; otherwise any refusal gives refused; dispute applies when no refusal; paid only when all paid.

multi.order.assumption: Products are handled in the account's order.

quotes: For calls made on or after 4 November 2026, the `close_call` reason `hardship` is replaced by `financial_difficulty` (outcome stays `no_promise`).

changes.assumption: No value changes on a date; only a code changes (see event_changes).

assumptions: The brief's opening says "This call is recorded." The spec rules require active voice, so the line says "We record this call."
The opening question is written with {amount}, which the engine already speaks with the currency. So "EUR {amount}" became "{amount}" to avoid saying the currency twice.
No title call variable is given, so confirm_ask uses {first_name} {last_name}, as B.1 says.
max_wrong = 2, because the second wrong answer across both questions ends verification. This overrides the API summary's three.
A spoken numeric date of birth is read day, month, year (date_order dmy).
opening_is_attempt = true, so ladder step 1 is the opening ask (full amount, today). The tier attempts (2 and 3) include the opening ask.

Tier 2 deadline: the 15th is rolled to next month only if it is before today. The move forward to a business day happens after the roll (roll_before_adjust). When today is the 15th, the deadline is today.
Tier 1 deadline is the 6th business day after today, never counting today.
deadline_adjust = next_business_day, from D.3 and D.4.
Overdraft floor = 25% of overdue_eur, rounded up to a whole euro. If overdue_eur is below 100, the floor is the full overdue amount. Card floor = min_due_eur. Loan floor = monthly_instalment_eur.
Ladder step 2 (half) is rounded up to a whole euro, then raised to the floor if lower (built-in max with the floor).

Hardship gets no transfer. hardship_transfer = direct with an empty support queue: sympathy, notes on remaining products, then close no_promise/hardship. From 2026-11-04 the reason becomes financial_difficulty.
Several products with no promise: service_error ranks above refused, then dispute, then paid. The brief does not fully rank mixed endings.
No callback policy for weekends or non-business days beyond 'today or the next business day'; business_days_only left false.

Unstated items keep engine defaults: next_weekday following_week, max_not_talk 2, purpose_is_decline true, refuse_deadline_is_refusal true. Promise changes cannot be made on this call. max_unclear omitted.
No SMS or follow-up sentence is required after a recorded promise (sms_line empty).
